subject: Dedicated GPU onboarding roadmap & MAP — kickoff and owner alignment
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@helios.ai>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@okapi-systems.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Dedicated GPU MAP & throughput targets

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the deep dive last week. Our leadership is ready to move forward with a Dedicated capacity trial for Helios' inference workloads. We want to put a short mutual action plan (MAP) in place so both teams have clear owners, milestones, and an expected close timeline.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm throughput targets for the trial (rps & p99 latency budgets).
- Staffing: who will own the GPU pool provisioning, and who will be the day-to-day contact for eval coordination?
- Procurement timeline — we need an indicative close date by end of Q2 if possible.

Attached is a starter MAP and our initial throughput numbers (throughput-estimates.xlsx). We also copied Samir from Okapi — they're the partner doing network setup.

Can you propose owners and a short 4–6 week milestone plan? We prefer a 30–45 minute kickoff between teams this week or early next.

Best,
Elena Soto
Head of Platform Engineering
Helios AI

Attachment: throughput-estimates.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)
From: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@helios.ai>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@okapi-systems.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Dedicated GPU MAP & throughput targets

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the files. Copying the small cross-functional team who will run the MAP on our side and calling out proposed owners below so we can lock them in: 

Proposed Redwood owners (please confirm):
- MAP lead / commercial owner: connor_obrien (me) — point for timeline, SOW, and exec syncs
- Technical onboarding & GPU pool ops: marissa_cole — will run provisioning and throughput tuning
- Runtime/latency engineering: rishi_malhotra — handles p99 optimizations and KV/cache configs
- Security & compliance liaison: monica_patel — will manage evidence for your procurement audit if needed

Initial milestone outline (suggested 5-week MAP):
Week 0: Kickoff + finalize throughput targets and metrics (rps, p95/p99, seq len)
Week 1–2: Dedicated pool provisioning + baseline perf runs (Marissa)
Week 3: Evaluation with your sample traffic + tuning (Rishi)
Week 4: Regression/QA, compliance checklist (Monica)
Week 5: Close decision + SOW sign-off (Connor/Elena)

Close date: target close week of 2028-06-26 (that gets us a clean 5-week window). If you need earlier, we can compress to 3 weeks by overlapping provisioning and initial evals — will require an expedited PO.

I've attached a draft MAP and an editable SOW for your review. Proposed kickoff meeting slots below (30–45m):
- Thu 2028-05-23 10:00–10:45 PT
- Thu 2028-05-23 14:00–14:45 PT
- Fri 2028-05-24 09:30–10:15 PT

Please confirm owners and preferred slot.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (PDF, 110KB); SOW-draft.docx (document, 68KB)
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, Elena Soto <elena.soto@helios.ai>, Samir Khan <samir.khan@okapi-systems.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Dedicated GPU MAP & throughput targets

Looping in a few practical constraints from the ops side:
- Provisioning ETA for a fresh 8xA100 pool in us-west: 7 business days if we have PO and network VLAN details from Okapi. If Helios can accept a mixed-quantized instance (4xA100 + burst), we can shorten to 3 business days.
- Baseline perf runs need representative payloads (batch sizes, seq lengths). Elena — your attached workbook is great; can you add a sample traffic CSV for three hour-long windows?
- I'll own the provisioning checklist and will need remote access window to validate end-to-end (NAT rules + certs).

I'll prepare a runbook and share before the kickoff.

—Marissa
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@okapi-systems.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, Elena Soto <elena.soto@helios.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 May 2028 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Dedicated GPU MAP & throughput targets

Connor/Elena — quick note from Okapi: we can provision the network overlay and reserved IP ranges within 48–72 hours after we get the VLAN IDs and an architectural contact. Procurement (Helios) — ProcureOps will confirm any required MSA/PO flow; happy to coordinate with them.

Samir Khan
Solutions Architect, Okapi Systems
samir.khan@okapi-systems.com

Date: Thu, 24 May 2028 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Dedicated GPU MAP & throughput targets

Thanks — owners look good to me. Procurement (ProcureOps) confirms they can target a PO approval the week of 2028-06-12 if we keep to the 5-week plan. Samir — we'll send the VLAN IDs and a sample traffic CSV by end of day.

Confirming kickoff: Fri 2028-05-24 09:30–10:15 PT works for the Helios & Okapi team. Connor — please send calendar invite.

Next steps summary:
1) Connor: send calendar invite + final MAP doc (editable)
2) Elena: VLAN IDs + sample CSV (today EOD)
3) Marissa: provisioning runbook + list of firewall items needed (pre-kickoff)
4) Rishi: perf-run template and target metrics to validate (p95/p99, tail lat)
5) ProcureOps: confirm PO flow and any compliance docs needed (timeline week of 2028-06-12)

Looking forward — Elena

--
Elena Soto
Head of Platform Engineering, Helios AI
Elena.Soto@helios.ai
